title: hololive Alternative Project's Holoearth Game to End Service on June 28
content: The official website for Holoearth , a game project within Cover Corporation's hololive Alternative metaverse project , announced on Thursday that the game will end service on June 28 at 9:00 p.m. JST (8:00 a.m. EDT).

title: One of The Best Action Series of 2020s Unveils New Look Amid Season 3 Delay
content: Wind Breaker is one of the most acclaimed high school action series in recent years. The anime is based on the ongoing manga by Satoru Nii, which began serialization in Kodansha’s Magazine pocket . The anime originally debuted in 2024 and released a sequel a year later, both of which became major hits on Crunchyroll.

title: Patlabor EZY Anime Presents Trailer, Visual for 'File 2' Movie
content: The official website for the Patlabor EZY anime project unveiled the full trailer and key visual for "File 2," the anime's second compilation film containing its fourth to sixth episodes, on Friday. "File 2" will open on August 14.

title: Yū Miki's The Bateren Tales Manga Resumes on May 22
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ editor-in-chief Seijirō Nakaji announced on Wednesday that Yū Miki 's The Bateren Tales ( Bateren Kaidan ) manga will resume serialization on May 22. Nakaji added that the manga's first compiled book volume will ship on June 4.
